# Cameron Beebe, Ph.D.

> Dec. 2025–Oct. 2026 Appy.AI. AI Product Engineer on a multi-agent harness for Violet: a Chief of Staff that routes to specialist agents with scoped context for real workflows.
> Shipped a harness eval dashboard comparing batches of executions across configurations.
> 2021– The SciPhi Initiative. My LLC for AI research, consulting, and community outreach.
> 2021 Ph.D. from Graduate School of Systemic Neurosciences, LMU Munich.
> 2015 Masters in Logic and Philosophy of Science from MCMP, LMU Munich.
